forms.ex: Bitte schließ das Fenster, es zieht.
forms.exEn: Please close the window, there's a draught.

forms.en: lock; finish, complete (studies, a project); conclude (a contract)
forms.why: ab = off: you close a room off with a key, or close off a piece of work.
forms.ex: Hast du die Haustür abgeschlossen?
forms.exEn: Did you lock the front door?

forms.en: degree, qualification; end, conclusion; signing (of a contract)
forms.clue: the qualification (a school or university degree)
forms.why: What you have when you have completed (abgeschlossen) your studies.
forms.ex: Nach dem Abschluss möchte ich im Ausland arbeiten.
forms.exEn: After graduating I'd like to work abroad.

forms.en: connect, plug in (a device); join (sich, a group); follow on
forms.clue: to connect (a printer); to join (sich, a group)
forms.why: an = on, onto: you close one thing onto another, so they are joined.
forms.ex: Kannst du den Drucker an den Laptop anschließen?
forms.exEn: Can you connect the printer to the laptop?

forms.en: connection (a train, the internet); contact (with people)
forms.clue: the connection (a train you change to)
forms.ex: Ich habe meinen Anschluss in Köln verpasst.
forms.exEn: I missed my connection in Cologne.

forms.why: Following on (anschließend = joining on) from what came before.
forms.ex: Wir essen zuerst und gehen anschließend spazieren.
forms.exEn: We'll eat first and then go for a walk.

forms.why: aus = out: you shut someone or something out.
forms.ex: Einen Fehler kann ich nicht ausschließen.
forms.exEn: I can't rule out a mistake.

forms.ex: Die Sitzung findet unter Ausschluss der Öffentlichkeit statt.
forms.exEn: The meeting is held behind closed doors.

forms.why: Everything else is shut out (ausgeschlossen), so only this is left.
forms.ex: Der Parkplatz ist ausschließlich für Kunden.
forms.exEn: The car park is for customers only.

forms.en: decide, resolve; pass (a law, a budget)
forms.clue: to decide (often together, formally); to pass (a law)
forms.why: be- + close: a discussion is closed with a decision.
forms.ex: Wir haben beschlossen, nach Berlin umzuziehen.
forms.exEn: We have decided to move to Berlin.

forms.ex: Der Stadtrat hat einen neuen Beschluss gefasst.
forms.exEn: The city council has passed a new resolution.

forms.en: sich entschließen: decide, make up your mind
forms.why: Learn it as a word: ent- + close does not explain it; you settle a choice for yourself.
forms.ex: Sie hat sich entschlossen, Medizin zu studieren.
forms.exEn: She has decided to study medicine.

forms.ex: Das war ein schwerer Entschluss für mich.
forms.exEn: That was a hard decision for me.

forms.why: Someone who has decided (sich entschlossen hat) and does not hesitate.
forms.ex: Die Regierung will entschlossen gegen die Armut kämpfen.
forms.exEn: The government wants to fight poverty with determination.

forms.ex: Ich bin noch unentschlossen, welches Handy ich nehme.
forms.exEn: I still can't decide which phone to take.

forms.en: open up, develop (an area, a market); work out (a meaning)
forms.clue: to open up (an area); to work out
forms.why: er = open, fully: you unlock an area or a meaning so it can be used.
forms.ex: Die Stadt will ein neues Wohngebiet erschließen.
forms.exEn: The town wants to develop a new residential area.

forms.why: ver = completely: you close it so that it stays shut.
forms.ex: Bitte verschließen Sie die Flasche nach dem Öffnen gut.
forms.exEn: Please close the bottle tightly after opening.

forms.clue: the cap, the fastener (of a bottle, bag)
forms.ex: Der Verschluss der Flasche ist kaputt.
forms.exEn: The cap of the bottle is broken.

forms.why: reißen = pull hard: a fastener you pull open and shut.
forms.ex: Der Reißverschluss an meiner Jacke klemmt.
forms.exEn: The zip on my jacket is stuck.

forms.why: Locked; a person who keeps himself locked up is reserved.
forms.ex: Als wir ankamen, war die Tür verschlossen.
forms.exEn: When we arrived, the door was locked.

forms.why: auf = open: you make it open with a key.
forms.ex: Warte, ich schließe dir die Tür auf.
forms.exEn: Wait, I'll unlock the door for you.

forms.why: Unlocked: a person who is open to new ideas.
forms.ex: Meine neuen Kollegen sind sehr aufgeschlossen.
forms.exEn: My new colleagues are very open-minded.

forms.clue: to lock in; to include (in a price)
forms.why: ein = in: you close something in, so it is inside.
forms.ex: Der Preis schließt das Frühstück ein.
forms.exEn: The price includes breakfast.

forms.why: Shut in (eingeschlossen), so it counts as part of it.
forms.ex: Das Zimmer kostet 80 Euro einschließlich Frühstück.
forms.exEn: The room costs 80 euros including breakfast.

forms.en: sich zusammenschließen: join forces, merge, unite
forms.why: zusammen = together: groups close themselves together into one.
forms.ex: Die beiden Firmen haben sich zusammengeschlossen.
forms.exEn: The two companies have merged.

forms.ex: Der Zusammenschluss der beiden Vereine war eine gute Idee.
forms.exEn: Merging the two clubs was a good idea.

forms.clue: the end (of a film, a story)
forms.ex: Zum Schluss möchte ich mich bei allen bedanken.
forms.exEn: Finally, I'd like to thank everyone.

forms.why: An argument that leads to a sound conclusion (Schluss).
forms.note: The stem takes an umlaut: Schluss, schlüssig.
forms.ex: Seine Argumente sind leider nicht schlüssig.
forms.exEn: Unfortunately his arguments are not conclusive.

forms.note: die Schlussfolgerung: a compound takes the gender of its last part, die Folgerung.
forms.ex: Welche Schlussfolgerung ziehen Sie aus den Zahlen?
forms.exEn: What conclusion do you draw from the figures?

forms.en: finally, in the end; after all
forms.why: At the close: what comes when things are closed.
forms.ex: Schließlich haben wir doch ein Taxi genommen.
forms.exEn: In the end we took a taxi after all.

forms.ex: Am Sonntag ist der Supermarkt geschlossen.
forms.exEn: The supermarket is closed on Sunday.

forms.why: The thing that closes (a lock); a castle was a closed-off stronghold.
forms.note: das Schloss: a bare-stem noun but neuter. It shares its tiles with der Schluss, so only der Schluss goes on a board.
forms.ex: Am Wochenende besichtigen wir ein altes Schloss.
forms.exEn: At the weekend we're visiting an old castle.

forms.ex: Die Schließung der Fabrik kostet viele Arbeitsplätze.
forms.exEn: The closure of the factory costs many jobs.
